entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Patna
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned A.P.P. for the State.

2. The petitioner apprehends arrest in connection with Cheriya Bariyarpur P.S. Case No. 10 of 2023 dated 18.01.2023, instituted for the offence punishable under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471 an 120(B)
of the Indian Penal Code.
3. The allegation against the petitioner is that the petitioner has been appointed as Niyojit Teacher in Primary School on the basis of forged marksheet of matriculation.
4. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner is innocent and he has been falsely implicated in this case.

It is further submitted that vide letter no. 3194 of District Education Officer,
the date of dismissal has been shown as Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.35941 of 2023(2)
dt.21-07-2023 22.08.2022 whereas much before his dismissal, the petitioner was asked not to sign on attendance register on 22.09.2021 vide letter no. 550 of Block Education Officer.
Lastly, it has been submitted that he has no criminal antecedents.
5. Learned A.P.P. has opposed the prayer for bail of the petitioner.

sentences.text:
Having considered the facts and circumstances of the case and submissions of learned counsel for the parties, in the event of arrest/surrender of the petitioner in connection with Cheriya Bariyarpur P.S. Case No. 10 of 2023, he shall be released on anticipatory bail upon furnishing bail bonds of Rs.
10,000/- (ten thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the learned A.C.J.M., Manjhaul, subject to condition as laid down under Section 438(2) of the Cr.P.C.
(Khatim Reza, J) prabhat/-
